verdict.rationale: Docs position Sandboxes as infrastructure for AI agents to execute code, maintain state via sessions, and integrate with Workers bindings (KV/R2/Durable Objects) which could support agent-driven background tasks, but there's no explicit scheduling/cron/trigger mechanism for autonomous automation, and community feedback notes no built-in idle-timeout auto-destroy, forcing manual cleanup logic. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger API for autonomous jobs, evidence of long-running unattended automation success, first-party guide on building 'set-and-forget' agent automations.
